guide: [[@2611.34449|HoloBrain-0.5]] 把 15 类本体的关节坐标统一后混训，跨臂零样本迁移得分是 π0.5 的 3.6 倍；论文真正推荐的配方是用离散动作头初始化、再换上扩散头。[[@2611.29483|行为结构对齐]]发现给 π0.5 加现成视觉编码器做表征对齐，扰动下成功率反掉 10–39 个点，有没有用取决于教师的行为结构指标是否高于学生。[[@2611.30490|EgoStudy]] 把人类第一视角数据扩到 100 倍，误差下降几乎全在手腕平移，手指和接触仍得靠机器人数据。

[[@2611.34778|Harness 设计研究]]跑了超过 47 万次 rollout，结论是 VLM 和 VLA 的分工要随两边的能力调整，参考方案 X-Harness 不改权重最多提升 42.8 个点。[[@2611.33010|镜子测试]]在场景里放一面镜子，五个策略的成功率就下降 10.8–56.7 个点，其中 50–88% 的失败根本没碰到镜子，是被倒影骗了。[[@2611.28873|NAT]]在 4.9 万小时动作数据上训练动作分词器，只用人手动作训练的版本表现接近用机器人数据训练的。[[@2611.30813|HIVE-Bench]]比较了 20 个视觉编码器，把每个视角平均成一个 token 会丢掉大部分成功率。

papers.title: HoloBrain-0.5 Technical Report
papers.title_zh: 统一机器人关节坐标后，跨臂零样本迁移得分是 π0.5 的 3.6 倍
papers.summary_zh: 面向跨本体操作的 VLA 模型族，在超过 1 万小时、15 类本体数据上预训练，离散与连续两种动作头，微调后超过 π0.5。
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出 HoloBrain-0.5，一个面向跨机器人本体操作的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型族。策略利用机器人状态、运动学结构和经过标定的相机观测，在==共享动作空间==中进行规划。我们对机器人描述文件（URDF）中的关节轴、坐标系和工具中心点进行标准化，并把它们的运动学图编码进共享的 3D 表示。HoloBrain-0.5-Continuous 用扩散生成动作块，HoloBrain-0.5-Discrete 则采用==残差有限标量量化（FSQ）==和==延迟自回归==。我们在超过 10,000 小时的真机、仿真和人手操作数据上预训练两种策略，数据覆盖 15 类本体。在六个闭环仿真设置中，离散策略比连续策略收敛更快、平均成功率更高（56.77% 对 49.71%）。在七个真机任务上，它无需任务专门的后训练即可达到 87.76% 的平均进度分。经过后训练，连续策略在七任务基准（94.52% 对 86.25%）和 11 个任务的双臂基准（79.07% 对 69.41%）上均超过 π0.5。用离散策略初始化的连续策略把五个任务从 Piper 零样本迁移到 Piper-X，平均得分 63.28%。使用目标机器人的示范后，连续策略在 Franka Panda 上得分 89.2%，在移动双臂平台上得分 92.94%。尽管预训练不包含任何 Unitree G1 数据，用有限的 G1 示范进行后训练后，三个人形任务的平均进度分达到 70.24%，**而 π0.5 为 11.00%**。
papers.abstract_en: We present HoloBrain-0.5, a family of vision-language-action (VLA) models for manipulation across robot embodiments. The policies plan in a shared action space using robot state, kinematic structure, and calibrated camera observations. We standardize joint axes, coordinate frames, and tool-center points in robot descriptions (URDFs) and encode their kinematic graphs in a shared 3D representation. HoloBrain-0.5-Continuous generates action chunks by diffusion, while HoloBrain-0.5-Discrete uses residual finite scalar quantization (FSQ) and delayed autoregression. We pretrain both policies on over 10,000 hours of real-robot, simulation, and human-manipulation data spanning 15 embodiment categories. Across six closed-loop simulation settings, the discrete policy converges faster and reaches a higher mean success rate than the continuous policy (56.77% vs. 49.71%). On seven real-robot tasks, it achieves a mean progress score of 87.76% without task-specific post-training. After post-training, the continuous policy outperforms $π_{0.5}$ on the seven-task benchmark (94.52% vs. 86.25%) and an 11-task dual-arm benchmark (79.07% vs. 69.41%). The discrete-initialized continuous policy transfers five tasks zero-shot from Piper to Piper-X, scoring 63.28% on average. With target-robot demonstrations, the continuous policy scores 89.2% on Franka Panda and 92.94% on a mobile dual-arm platform. Although pretraining includes no Unitree G1 data, post-training with limited G1 demonstrations yields a mean progress score of 70.24% across three humanoid tasks, compared with 11.00% for $π_{0.5}$.
analysis: 地平线的 HoloBrain-0.5 追问的是：关节数、坐标约定各不相同的机器人数据，能不能放进同一个动作空间一起训练。结果偏正面：只用 Piper 示范学的 5 个任务直接搬到 Piper-X（传感器相同、运动学结构不同），平均[[progress-score|进度分]] 63.28%，π0.5 只有 17.44%；预训练里完全没有的 Unitree G1 人形，用少量示范微调后 **70.24% 对 11.00%**。

做法分三块。==URDF 标准化==：把每个关节的转轴统一改成局部 +z，工具中心点（TCP，夹爪两指中点）朝外为 +z，同时补偿子连杆坐标，保证物理运动和已录轨迹不变，15 类本体都按此处理并做数值校验。模型把关节图（8 到 54 个节点）和相机标定一起当输入。动作头有两种：连续版用扩散生成[[action-chunk|动作块]]；离散版先用==虚拟关节==压缩轨迹，再用残差 [[fsq|FSQ]] 编码，按“虚拟关节、时间片、残差层”三个下标之和分组做==延迟自回归==，192 个码 21 轮生成完。预训练共 10,006.5 小时，真机 57%、仿真 35%、人手视频 8%。
全文最值得记住的是两种动作头的取舍。离散版收敛快、开箱即用更强（7 个真机任务不微调就有 87.76%），**但用每任务 200 条示范微调后反而跌到 69.74%**，作者承认它不适合少样本后训练。于是后面所有跨本体实验用的都是“用离散版初始化、再换上扩散头”的连续版（D-Init），它在 11 个双臂任务上 79.07%，比 π0.5 高 9.66 个点，这才是论文实际推荐的配方。
保留意见：所有真机分数都是带部分得分的里程碑进度分，没有报告每个任务的试验次数和方差；G1 实验还叠加了自家的 HoloMotion-1 全身跟踪器，人形上 59 个点的差距有多少来自控制栈而非 VLA 本身说不清。对做多本体数据混训的团队，可以直接拿走的是开源的 UniURDF 工具和权重：先统一坐标约定再混数据，并试试用离散预训练给扩散策略做初始化。
star_reasons: 跨本体 VLA 的核心问题：用标准化 URDF 关节图统一 15 类本体的动作空间
真机评测覆盖 5 种本体、30 多个任务，并与在同样数据上微调的 π0.5 对比
代码、UniURDF 工具与模型权重均已开源
揭示离散动作头开箱强但少样本微调会退化，离散预训练再接扩散头更好

figures.caption_zh: 整体结构：Qwen3.5-2B 编码指令、参考图和当前观测，加上相机参数和标准化的机器人状态，再接扩散头（连续版）或延迟自回归加 ==FSQ== 解码器（离散版）。右侧是预训练数据构成：真机 5700+ 小时、仿真 3400+ 小时、人手 800+ 小时。
预训练过程中六个仿真设置的平均成功率：离散版（56.77%）始终在连续版（49.71%）之上，用离散版初始化的连续版 D-Init 几乎追平离散版（56.65%）。
==URDF 标准化==：左边把绕局部 x 轴转的关节改成绕 z 轴转，右边把左手系的 TCP 坐标改成朝外为 +z 的右手系，物理运动保持不变。
离散版的动作分词器：真实关节和==虚拟关节==一起过图注意力，只保留虚拟关节特征，再用残差 FSQ 编成“虚拟关节 × 时间片 × 残差层”的码网格。
==延迟自回归==：三个下标之和相同的码在同一轮一起预测，每个码用一个“cue”位置来预测数值，比逐个生成少很多轮。
Unitree G1 人形的标准化关节图（31 个节点），左边投影到相机画面，右边是机器人基座坐标系下的同一张图。

papers.title: EgoStudy: How Does Scaling Egocentric Data Affect VLA and WAM Pretraining?
papers.title_zh: 人类第一视角数据扩 100 倍，只教会机器人挪手腕，没教会动手指
papers.affiliation: 清华大学；上海期智研究院；上海交通大学；香港科技大学（广州）
papers.summary_zh: 固定机器人数据，系统性改变第一视角人类数据的规模与多样性，研究其对VLA预训练的作用。
papers.abstract_zh: 第一视角的人类操作数据是训练灵巧机器人策略的一个可扩展的数据来源。然而，由于人与机器人之间的 ==embodiment gap==，机器人能从这些数据中学到多少、获益多少仍不清楚。我们提出 EgoStudy，一项针对机器人学习中第一视角数据的系统性对照研究。在固定机器人数据集的前提下，我们改变第一视角数据的规模与多样性、数据处理策略以及 co-training 配置。我们研究三个问题：(1) 哪些数据处理和预训练选择最能有效利用第一视角数据？(2) 机器人动作预测的哪些组成部分从扩大这类数据中获益最多？(3) 扩大数据的效果在视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）和 ==世界-动作模型（WAM）== 之间有何不同？实验得出三项主要发现。第一，数据多样性、轨迹之间的对齐以及详细的语言标注是有效迁移的关键因素。第二，**扩大第一视角数据对末端执行器平移预测的提升大于对精细手指动作预测的提升**。第三，**第一视角数据有限时 WAM 表现更好，而随着数据量增加，VLA 的收益更大**。这些发现为如何处理和使用第一视角数据来训练 VLA 与 WAM 提供了实用指导，并厘清了扩大这类数据的收益与局限。
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric human manipulation data offer a scalable resource for training dexterous robot policies. However, how effectively robots can learn and benefit from these data remains unclear due to the embodiment gap between humans and robots. We present EgoStudy, a systematic, controlled study of egocentric data for robot learning. Holding the robot dataset fixed, we vary the scale and diversity of egocentric data, data processing strategies, and co-training configurations. We investigate three questions: (1) Which data processing and pretraining choices most effectively exploit egocentric data? (2) Which components of robot action prediction benefit most from scaling these data? (3) How do scaling effects differ between vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world-action models (WAMs)? Our experiments yield three main findings. First, data diversity, alignment between trajectories, and detailed language annotations are key factors in effective transfer. Second, scaling egocentric data yields larger gains in predicting end-effector translation than in predicting fine-grained finger movements. Third, WAMs perform better when egocentric data are limited, whereas VLAs exhibit greater gains as the amount of egocentric data increases. Together, these findings provide practical guidance on processing and using egocentric data to train VLAs and WAMs, while clarifying the benefits and limitations of scaling these data.
analysis: **人类视频有用，但几乎只用在手腕平移上。**这篇做的是控制变量实验：机器人数据（真机双臂灵巧手 XHand 约 273 小时、仿真 RoboCasa-GR1 约 81 小时）和训练步数固定，只把第一视角人类数据从 1% 加到 100%（过滤后约 1,850 小时，原始视频约 18,000 小时）。VLA（视觉-语言-动作模型）在 XHand 留出集上的手腕平移误差降了 20.2%，[[world-action-model|WAM]]（世界-动作模型）降了 18.8%；手腕旋转和指尖位姿的误差没有一致下降。

两类模型共用一个 ==共享灵巧动作空间==：每只手 1 个手腕位姿加 5 个指尖位姿，共 108 维，一次预测 32 步的[[action-chunk|动作块]]，人手位姿来自标注或追踪，机器人手来自正运动学。VLA 是 Qwen3-VL-4B 加 GR00T 式动作专家，WAM 是 Fast-WAM，用 Wan2.1 14B 视频模型同时预测未来画面和动作。数据处理的消融里，切成 ==语义完整片段==、用详细字幕（对照组只有“动词 + 物体”两个词）、多来源混合都更好：只用 EgoDex 一个来源时误差是混合数据的 2.8–5.7 倍。

更值得记住的是两类模型吃数据的方式不同。WAM 在每个规模上验证 loss 都更低，RoboCasa 闭环成功率从 39.6% 升到 45.4%，VLA 从 38.3% 升到 43.8%；摘要说 WAM 只在数据少时更好，正文里其实是 VLA 的斜率更大、WAM 的绝对值一直更低。随数据增加，VLA 里人和机器人画面的 ==特征分离度== 持续缩小，WAM 各层都不收敛。换骨干后，VLA 用 4B 和 8B 降幅相当；**WAM 换成 Wan2.2 5B 后误差几乎不随人类数据下降**，作者据此认为 WAM 吸收人类数据要靠大视频骨干。
**闭环评测只有仿真**：RoboCasa 24 个任务各跑 10 次，真机 XHand 只报离线 MSE，没有真机成功率，也没有和同样时长的机器人数据比较；只用 EgoDex 那组的差距里还混着机器人监督的变化，作者自己也承认。对正在采人类视频做预训练的团队：先做切段、详细字幕和多来源混合，别指望它解决手指和接触这类精细动作，那部分仍要靠机器人数据；走 WAM 路线的要配足够大的视频骨干。
star_reasons: 控制变量回答了具身数据的核心问题：人类视频加到多少、对哪部分动作有用
同一动作空间、同一数据下对比 VLA 和 WAM 两条路线，并拆到手腕平移、旋转和指尖
给出切段、字幕、来源混合、采样方式的可直接照做的消融结论，以及手指不受益的反面证据

figures.caption_zh: 研究设计总览：左上是固定机器人数据、只扩人类数据的设定；右上是手腕平移误差随人类数据比例（约 180 到 18,000 小时原始视频）的对数拟合，**VLA 斜率更大，WAM 绝对值更低**；下排是三个问题各自的结论。
按动作分量拆开看误差：左列手腕平移随数据增加一路下降，中列手腕旋转和右列指尖位姿基本是平的。**人类数据帮的是大范围移动，不是手指精细动作。**
换骨干的对比：VLA 用 Qwen3-VL 4B 和 8B 的下降曲线几乎重合；WAM 从 Wan2.1 14B 换到 Wan2.2 5B 后，曲线变平，人类数据带来的收益基本消失。
人和机器人画面的 ==特征分离度== R：VLA 最后一层随数据增加持续下降，WAM 第 10–40 层都没有一致下降。作者猜测是因为 WAM 还要预测未来画面，得保留人手和机械手的外观差别。
RoboCasa-GR1 仿真闭环成功率（24 个任务、共 240 次）：人类数据从 1% 到 100%，VLA 38.3%→43.8%，WAM 39.6%→45.4%，虚线是不做人类数据预训练的基线。
来源多样性：同为约 30% 的人类数据量，只用 EgoDex 时手腕平移误差是多来源混合的 2.8–5.7 倍。

papers.title: Representation Alignment Is Only as Good as the Teacher's Behavioral Structure
papers.title_zh: 给 VLA 做表征对齐要看行为结构：现成编码器反让扰动成功率掉 39 点
papers.affiliation: 东京大学、中国科学院大学、新加坡国立大学、香港科技大学等
papers.summary_zh: 在 14 个教师和 16 个操作任务上发现，现成视觉编码器对齐不能提升 π0.5 的干净成功率，扰动下成功率还降低 10 到 39 个点。
papers.abstract_zh: 近期工作在微调视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型时，把它的中间特征与冻结的视觉编码器对齐，希望注入 3D 感知或 affordance 等额外先验。在图像生成中，表征对齐（REPA）的教师用编码器自身的指标来评估；而 VLA 的教师目前大多凭经验挑选。我们表明这种做法并不可靠：在 14 个教师和 16 个操作任务上、相同训练预算下，**没有任何现成视觉编码器能让 π0.5 的干净环境成功率提高超过 1 个点，而且它们全部使扰动下的成功率下降 10 到 39 个点**。图像生成中使用的两个标准——全局语义和空间结构——都无法预测哪些教师有帮助。因此我们提出 ==行为结构指标（BSM）==，它衡量在教师特征空间中相近的状态，在同一任务内是否跟随相似的专家动作。BSM 与扰动下的成功率强相关（r=0.87），并且所有现成视觉编码器的得分都低于 π0.5 本身。基于此，我们提出 ==Behavior-Aware VLA Alignment（BAVA）==，这是一个通用的 VLA 对齐协议：优先选择 BSM 高于学生的视觉编码器，并在训练中根据学生的 BSM 提前停止对齐。在 SmolVLA 上，**BAVA 只用三分之一的对齐预算就达到持续对齐的效果，平均成功率比不对齐的微调高 4.6 个点**。我们的结果表明，只有当教师编码了丰富的、与行为相关的结构时，表征对齐才会对 VLA 有益。
papers.abstract_en: Recent works align the intermediate features of vision-language-action (VLA) models with frozen vision encoders during fine-tuning, hoping to inject additional priors such as 3D awareness or affordances. Unlike in image generation, where teachers for representation alignment (REPA) are assessed with encoder-intrinsic metrics, teachers for VLAs are still chosen largely by heuristics. We show that this practice is unreliable: across 14 teachers and 16 manipulation tasks, under matched training budgets, no off-the-shelf vision encoder improves the clean success rate of $π_{0.5}$ by more than 1 point, and all of them reduce its success rate under perturbations by 10 to 39 points. Neither global semantics nor spatial structure, the criteria used in image generation, predicts which teachers help. We therefore propose the behavioral structure metric (BSM), which measures whether states that are close in a teacher's feature space are followed by similar expert actions within the same task. BSM correlates strongly with success rate under perturbations ($r=0.87$), and every off-the-shelf vision encoder scores below $π_{0.5}$ itself. Based on it, we introduce Behavior-Aware VLA Alignment (BAVA), a general VLA alignment protocol that favors vision encoders whose BSM exceeds the student's and stops alignment early according to the student's BSM during training. On SmolVLA, BAVA matches continuous alignment with one third of the alignment budget, and improves the average success rate by 4.6 points over unaligned fine-tuning. Our results suggest that representation alignment benefits VLAs only when the teacher encodes rich behaviorally relevant structure.
analysis: **以 π0.5 为学生时，11 个现成视觉编码器做对齐教师，没有一个让干净环境成功率涨过 1 个点，加入干扰物、随机纹理和光照后反而掉 10–39 个点。**这里的对齐指 [[repa|表征对齐]]：[[vla]] 微调时把中间层视觉 token 拉向冻结编码器的特征，推理时去掉教师。作者在 RoboTwin 16 个操作任务上测了 14 个教师，图像生成里挑教师的两个指标——ImageNet 线性探测准确率和 ==LDS==（近处 patch 比远处 patch 更相似的程度）——与扰动下成功率的相关系数只有 0.17 和 −0.52，都不显著。

作者提出 ==行为结构指标（BSM）==：用教师特征在同一任务的示范里检索 10 个最近邻状态，算它们接下来 50 步专家动作与当前状态的距离，除以随机状态的期望距离，再用 1 减去。BSM 与扰动下成功率的相关系数 r=0.87，换邻居数、动作长度和动作表示后仍在 0.80–0.89。**关键是和学生自己比**：π0.5 自身 BSM 为 0.497，所有现成编码器都更低；唯一帮到它的是用扰动环境示范训练过的 π0.5 oracle（BSM 0.669，扰动成功率 +25 个点）。据此得到 ==BAVA==：选 BSM 高于学生的教师，学生 BSM 超过教师并不再上升时关掉对齐损失。

最有说服力的是附录表 8：同一个 DINOv2 教师（BSM 0.509）对四个学生，OpenVLA-OFT（0.314）+8.25 个点，SmolVLA +4.31，π0 −4.69，π0.5 −11.94，随学生 BSM 升高单调变差。SmolVLA 上 BAVA 把平均成功率从 31.56% 提到 36.19%；AlohaMini2 真机 3 个任务各 20 次，成功 22 次，无对齐 18 次，Spatial Forcing 12 次。

保留意见：**正收益只出现在弱学生上**，早停版和全程对齐是 36.19% 对 35.88%，早停省的是计算而不是精度；真机每个设置只有 10 次试验。我怀疑 r=0.87 很大程度靠 Random ViT（7%）和 oracle（83%）两个极端点撑起，论文没报去掉它们后的相关性。对用 π0.5、π0 这类强基座微调的团队：加 VGGT、DINOv2 对齐之前，先在自己的示范上算一遍 BSM（只要前向和最近邻检索），学生更高就别加。
star_reasons: 14 个教师 × 4 个学生 × 4 种对齐方式的对照实验，直接否定了“给 VLA 对齐 3D/语义编码器就能补先验”的常见做法
提出无需训练即可算的 BSM，与扰动下成功率相关 r=0.87，并给出“教师要比学生强”的可操作判据
在扰动设置下评测，暴露了干净 benchmark 上看不到的 10–39 个点鲁棒性损失，并有 AlohaMini2 真机验证

figures.caption_zh: 三种挑教师的指标：上排示意各自在问什么，下排是 14 个教师对齐 π0.5 后的扰动下成功率。看右下：只有 ==BSM== 与成功率强相关（r=0.87），线性探测（r=0.17）和 LDS（r=−0.52）都不显著。
BSM 在算什么：对同一个按闹钟的查询状态，DINOv2 找到的两个近邻接下来都会合上左夹爪（动作距离 0.09、0.03），DA3 找到的近邻夹爪一直张开（0.66、0.68）。近邻的后续动作越像，BSM 越高。
复现 Spatial Forcing（π0.5 对齐 VGGT）：干净环境 5k 步时领先 5.25 个点，25k 步后优势消失；扰动环境到 50k 步反而低 12.88 个点。下排是同一回合，对齐后夹爪把方块碰倒、抓空。
AlohaMini2 双臂真机的三个任务与干净/扰动两种设置，底部是 SmolVLA 每格 10 次试验的成功率：BAVA 在 6 个格子里都不低于无对齐，扰动设置从 10% 提到 20%。
更多检索例子：SAM3（扰动下 BSM 0.423）的近邻在四个任务里都跟着查询做几乎同样的夹爪和关节动作，MAE（0.133）只有按闹钟那一例对得上。

papers.title: NAT: Scaling Causal Neural Action Tokenizers Across Embodiments
papers.title_zh: NAT：跨具身扩展的因果神经动作 Tokenizer
papers.summary_zh: 在 4.9 万小时真机、手持夹爪、仿真与人类动作数据上训练通用动作 Tokenizer。
papers.abstract_zh: 动作分词器让机器人策略能把控制当作自回归的下一 token 预测。随着这些策略在更大、更多样的数据集上训练，它们需要一个通用分词器，能编码来自多种本体和数据来源的动作，包括没见过的。我们在规模上研究动作分词，训练数据为来自真实机器人、手持夹爪、仿真和人类的 49k 小时动作数据。我们提出 ==Neural Action Tokenizer（NAT）==，一种因果分词器，其解码器让动作可以在 token 生成的同时被执行。在四个仿真基准上，对未见过的机器人本体做分词时，NAT 优于 FAST 和已有的神经动作分词器；在视觉-语言-动作模型中，它在四个基准上优于 FAST+，并在真实机器人上通过其 token 执行动作时同样更好。在部分基准上，NAT token 还缩小了与 flow-matching 动作头的性能差距，同时降低了首个动作的推理延迟。实验还发现，学习有效的动作空间可能并不需要机器人数据：**仅用人手动作训练的 NAT，表现接近用机器人数据训练的分词器**。
papers.abstract_en: Action tokenizers let robot policies treat control as autoregressive next-token prediction. As these policies are trained on larger and more diverse datasets, they will need a universal tokenizer that can encode actions from many embodiments and data sources, including ones it has not seen. We study action tokenization at scale, training on 49k hours of action data from real-world robots, handheld grippers, simulation, and humans. We introduce Neural Action Tokenizer (NAT), a causal tokenizer whose decoder lets actions be executed as their tokens are generated. Across four simulation benchmarks, NAT outperforms FAST and prior neural action tokenizers when tokenizing unseen robot embodiments, and in vision-language-action models it outperforms FAST+ across four benchmarks and on a real robot when acting through its tokens. NAT tokens also close the performance gap to a flow-matching action head on some benchmarks while lowering the inference latency for first actions. Our experiments also find that robot data may not be necessary to learn an effective action space: a NAT trained only on human hand motion performs close to tokenizers trained on robot data.

papers.title: Toward Agentic Robotics: A Large-Scale Study of Harness Design for Robot-Use Agents
papers.title_zh: 迈向 Agent 式机器人：机器人使用型 Agent 的 harness 设计大规模研究
papers.summary_zh: 在 8 个仿真基准、6 个 VLM、15 个 VLA/WAM 上做超过 47 万次 rollout，总结 harness 设计规律并给出 X-Harness。
papers.abstract_zh: 近期的视觉语言模型（VLM）可以充当 robot-use agent，理解多样场景，并通过策略代码和工具控制机器人。但即使延长推理，它们对 3D 夹爪位姿的预测仍然很差，难以完成精确操作。视觉语言动作模型（VLA）和世界动作模型（WAM）则相反：它们在训练过的任务上执行快速、平滑，却会在域偏移或任务需要长程记忆与推理时失败。因此，agentic robot 通过 policy harness 把 VLM 的推理与感知同 VLA/WAM 的精确控制结合起来。然而 harness 的设计有数千种配置，同样的模型下成功率可以相差几十个点。而且即便只测试一种设计，也要数千次 rollout，API 和 GPU 成本很高，所以已有工作往往只在少数备选中选定一种设计。为了指导 harness 设计，我们在八个仿真 benchmark、六个 VLM 和 15 个 VLA/WAM checkpoint 上评测了超过 470,000 次 rollout。七项对照研究表明，有效的 harness 必须同时适应 VLM 和 VLA/WAM 的能力。我们的发现指明了 VLM 的策略代码需要什么结构、VLA 操作在哪些地方需要工具和策略代码的帮助，以及测试时何时应当调用 VLM。参考方案 ==X-Harness== 表明这些发现无需更新权重即可组合起来，在记忆、推理和域偏移场景下把基础策略**最多提升 $+42.8$ 个点**。
papers.abstract_en: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) can act as robot-use agents that understand diverse scenes and control robots through policy code and tools. However, they predict 3D gripper poses poorly even with extended reasoning, struggling with precise manipulation. Vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action (WAM) models are the opposite: they execute fast, smooth control on trained tasks, yet fail under domain shifts or when tasks require long-horizon memory and reasoning. Agentic robots therefore combine VLM reasoning and perception with precise VLA/WAM control through a policy harness. Yet harness design spans thousands of configurations, shifting success by tens of points with the same models. Moreover, testing even one design takes thousands of rollouts at high API and GPU cost, so prior works often commit to a single design chosen from few alternatives. To guide harness design, we evaluate over 470,000 rollouts across eight simulation benchmarks, six VLMs, and 15 VLA/WAM checkpoints. Seven controlled studies show effective harnesses must adapt to both VLM and VLA/WAM capabilities. Our findings specify what structure the VLM's policy code needs, where VLA manipulation needs help from tools and policy code, and when to involve the VLM at test time. The reference recipe X-Harness shows that these findings compose without weight updates, lifting base policies up to $+42.8$ points across memory, reasoning, and domain shifts.

papers.title: Innata-0: A Native Embodied World System with Model-Agent Co-Design
papers.title_zh: Innata-0：模型与 Agent 协同设计的原生具身世界系统
papers.summary_zh: 把基础模型与 Agent 协同设计，支持长程、可靠的具身任务执行。
papers.abstract_zh: 物理世界是开放、动态且只能部分观测的。基础模型推动了具身智能的发展，但单独的模型难以完成长程执行，而简单地把模型和智能体拼在一起，又可能使规划与物理控制不一致。为了在物理世界中实现可靠且自适应的行为，我们提出 Innata-0，一个==原生具身世界系统==。Innata-0 联合设计具身世界-动作模型和智能体，发挥二者的互补优势。模型 Innata-0-WAM 采用三塔 Mixture-of-Transformers 架构，整合理解、预测和动作生成。智能体 Innata-0-Agent 通过记忆、验证和恢复来协调长程执行。我们还提出一套协同设计协议，使模型训练与智能体执行对齐，并利用经过验证的经验支持后续的适应和模型改进。大量评测表明，该系统在理解、世界预测和机器人操作上都具备较强的具身能力。Innata-0 是我们迈向物理智能的第一步，也是一段更长旅程的开端。
papers.abstract_en: The physical world is open-ended, dynamic, and partially observable. While foundation models have advanced embodied intelligence, standalone models struggle with long-horizon execution, and simply integrating models with agents may lead to inconsistencies between planning and physical control. To support reliable and adaptive behaviors in the physical world, we introduce Innata-0, a native embodied world system. Innata-0 jointly designs an embodied world-action model and an agent to combine their complementary strengths. The model, Innata-0-WAM, adopts a tri-tower Mixture-of-Transformers architecture that integrates understanding, prediction, and action generation. The agent, Innata-0-Agent, coordinates long-horizon execution through memory, verification, and recovery. A co-design protocol is further proposed to align model training with agent execution and leverage validated experiences to support subsequent adaptation and model improvement. Extensive evaluations demonstrate strong embodied capabilities across understanding, world prediction, and robotic manipulation. Innata-0 represents our first step toward physical intelligence, and we see it as the beginning of a much longer journey.

papers.title: Entangle: Scaling Human-Video In-Context World-Action Models across Unseen Tasks and Contexts
papers.title_zh: Entangle：跨未见任务与场景扩展人类视频上下文世界动作模型
papers.summary_zh: 用人类视频作为上下文，让世界动作模型在机器人操作中完成未见任务。
papers.abstract_zh: 上下文学习（ICL）使基础模型无需更新参数，就能根据上下文完成未见过的任务。在机器人操作中，人类视频可以作为说明任务该如何完成的上下文。然而，在世界-动作模型（WAM）上扩展人类视频 ICL 面临两个难题：任务级的人-机器人配对数据在时间上与机器人动作不对齐；标准的动作损失又允许策略依赖初始场景或任务身份这类捷径，而不去跟踪上下文。我们提出 Entangle，一个==上下文世界-动作模型==，它把一段人类视频和机器人当前观测映射为未来的视觉状态和可执行的动作。为了扩大时间对齐的训练数据，我们通过视频到视频生成，把录制的机器人视频转换成匹配的人类上下文，并辅以真实的配对录制。在模型训练中，我们结合变长视频窗口和==任务内对比目标==，让模型把配对的动作轨迹与同一任务的其他执行区分开，从而避免任务身份捷径。无需任务专属微调，Entangle 随对齐训练数据的增加而稳步提升，在 Astribot S1 机器人的六个未见任务上平均得分 83.5/100，在七个未见的 RoboTwin 任务上平均成功率为 **69.5%，比 Zero-WAM 高 22.6 个百分点**。在 Context-OOD 设置下，尽管只用场景对齐的配对数据训练，Entangle 仍能在重新布置的布局和替换的工具之间迁移上下文指定的行为。项目主页：https://entangle-robotics.github.io/
papers.abstract_en: In-context learning (ICL) enables foundation models to perform unseen tasks from context without parameter updates. In robotic manipulation, a human video provides the context that specifies how a task should be performed. However, scaling human-video ICL on world-action models (WAMs) faces two challenges: task-level human-robot pairs are not temporally aligned with robot actions, and standard action losses allow policies to rely on initial-scene or task-identity shortcuts rather than tracking the context. We present Entangle, an in-context world-action model that maps a single human video and current robot observations to future visual states and executable actions. To scale temporally aligned training data, we convert recorded robot videos into matched human contexts via video-to-video generation, supplemented by real paired recordings. For model training, we combine variable-length video windows with an intra-task contrastive objective that distinguishes the paired action trajectory from other executions of the same task, preventing task-identity shortcuts. Without task-specific fine-tuning, Entangle improves steadily as aligned training data scales, reaching an average score of 83.5/100 across six unseen tasks on an Astribot S1 robot, and achieves a 69.5% average success rate on seven unseen RoboTwin tasks, outperforming Zero-WAM by 22.6 percentage points. Under Context-OOD, although trained only on scene-aligned pairs, Entangle transfers context-specified behaviors across rearranged layouts and substituted tools. Project page at https://entangle-robotics.github.io/

papers.title: HIVE-Bench: Evaluating Patch-Level Visual Representations for Egocentric Robot Manipulation
papers.title_zh: HIVE-Bench：评估第一视角机器人操作中的patch级视觉表示
papers.summary_zh: 用同一flow-matching策略在24个双臂任务上比较7类共20个视觉编码器，发现保留patch token至关重要。
papers.abstract_zh: 预训练视觉模型是机器人学习常见的起点，但多数比较仍只对第三人称图像的一个池化向量打分。双臂策略实际读取的却是机器人自身相机的密集 patch token。我们提出 HIVE-Bench：用一个共享的 flow-matching 策略读取来自七个家族的 20 个编码器，在 24 个第一人称双臂任务上评测，涵盖适应、任务共享，以及数据量、模型规模和层数的扫描。==保留 patch 很重要==：把每个视角平均成一个 token 会丢掉大部分成功率，适应对我们测试的每一对都有帮助，而一个共享策略用少得多的更新量就保留了各独立策略的大部分成功率。随后我们用统计量、状态和物体读出、已发表的视觉评分，以及==逆动力学读出==为同样的 token 打分。对指令动作的这一读出，是策略训练前最强的度量之一。识别、深度和对应关系的能力不能可靠地迁移。微调可以改善动作读出，即使其他度量朝相反方向变化，而且没有哪个统计量稳定到足以在任何部署之前替代 rollout。
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained vision is a common start for robot learning, but most comparisons still score one pooled vector from a third-person image. Bimanual policies instead read dense patch tokens from cameras on the robot. We introduce HIVE-Bench: one shared flow-matching policy reads 20 encoders from seven families on 24 egocentric bimanual tasks, across adaptation, task sharing, and sweeps of data, model size, and layer. Keeping the patches matters. Averaging each view to one token removes most of the success, adaptation helps every pair we test, and one shared policy keeps most of the success of separate policies at a fraction of the updates. The same tokens are then scored with statistics, state and object readouts, published vision scores, and an inverse-dynamics readout. That readout of the commanded motion is one of the strongest measurements available before a policy is trained. Recognition, depth, and correspondence do not transfer reliably. Fine-tuning can improve the action readout even when other measurements move the other way, and no statistic is stable enough to replace a rollout before any deployment.

papers.title: DexEngine: Scaling Human Demonstrations into Physically Executable Whole-Robot Data
papers.title_zh: DexEngine：将人类演示扩展为物理可执行的全机器人数据
papers.summary_zh: 用仿真流水线把人手–物体演示大规模转成运动学可行、物理可执行的全机器人数据。
papers.abstract_zh: 近来有不少工作研究如何把人类手-物体演示重定向到机器人手上。但要训练全身机器人策略，重定向后的动作还必须在运动学上可行、在物理上可执行，并且能够大规模高效生成。我们提出 ==DexEngine==，一个仿真流水线，把人类操作数据转化为可直接训练、物理上可执行的手臂-手轨迹。DexEngine 先把每段数据中的手-物体运动放到手臂够得着的位置，再找到跟随人手的手臂运动，最后在物理仿真中用残差强化学习修正该运动。我们从九个人类手-物体数据集出发，为四种灵巧手各生成约 5,200 段片段，扩增后共得到 65,000 条轨迹（116 小时）和 325,000 个 episode（578 小时）。即使带着手臂，DexEngine 对物体的跟踪也比以往的浮动手方法更准确，并且比基于 RL 的方法**快 10 倍以上**。用我们的数据训练的策略远好于用同样片段但未做物理修正、或在浮动手修正后再接上手臂的数据训练的策略，说明微调数据需要 ==物理修正==。在相同微调预算下，用我们的数据做 mid-training 还能进一步提升这些策略，仿真和真机上都是如此。
papers.abstract_en: A growing body of recent work addresses the retargeting of human hand-object demonstrations to robotic hands. To train whole-robot policies, however, the retargeted motions must be kinematically feasible and physically executable, and be produced efficiently at scale. We present DexEngine, a simulation pipeline that turns human manipulation data into train-ready, physically executable arm-hand trajectories. DexEngine first places each clip's hand-object motion where the arms can reach it, finds an arm motion that follows the human hands, and then corrects the motion in physics simulation with residual reinforcement learning. From nine human hand-object datasets, we generate about 5,200 clips for each of four dexterous hands, augmented into 65,000 trajectories (116 h) and 325,000 episodes (578 h) in total. Even with arms attached, DexEngine tracks objects more accurately than prior floating-hand methods and runs over 10x faster than RL-based ones. Policies trained on our data far outperform those trained on the same clips without physics correction or with the arms attached after a floating-hand correction, showing that fine-tuning data need physics correction. Mid-training on our data further improves them at equal fine-tuning budget, in simulation and on a real robot.

papers.title: Nav4Manip: From Navigation to Dexterous Mobile Manipulation through Co-Evolution
papers.title_zh: Nav4Manip：通过协同演化从导航走向灵巧移动操作
papers.summary_zh: 导航与世界-动作模型操作相互反馈共同演化，并提出 Nav-N-Manip 基准，在 VLN 基准和真机上验证。
papers.abstract_zh: 灵巧移动操作是机器人在复杂、非结构化环境中完成有用任务的关键。然而现有系统面临两个挑战。其一，导航对下游操作来说过于粗糙：操作往往需要精确的底盘位置和接近朝向，而不只是到达米级的目标区域。其二，导航和操作通常各自独立训练，缺少让两种能力共同演化的反馈回路。这些局限使现有系统无法在真实环境中可靠地执行长程灵巧移动操作任务。为此，我们提出 ==Nav4Manip==，一个面向长程灵巧移动操作的双向耦合共同演化系统。它包含两个互补的架构：Nav4Manip-N 学习长程导航，并通过操作反馈改进其策略；Nav4Manip-M 则训练面向下游灵巧操作的世界动作模型（WAM）。我们分三个阶段训练 Nav4Manip-N：多任务联合微调学习导航行为和面向操作的 affordance 预测；拒绝采样微调（RFT）剔除策略生成的低质量路径，并在保留下来的轨迹上微调模型；基于 AI 反馈的强化学习（RLAIF）利用反事实偏好进一步改进导航决策。为支撑该框架，我们建立了 Nav-N-Manip benchmark，并从 benchmark rollout 中构建 Nav4Manip-Pairs，提供大规模的导航-操作配对轨迹和 affordance 监督。在公开的视觉语言导航（VLN）benchmark 和 Nav-N-Manip 上的大量实验显示出 **state-of-the-art 的性能**，真实环境评测也表明 Nav4Manip 能完成多种灵巧移动操作任务。项目主页：https://nav4manip.github.io/。
papers.abstract_en: Dexterous mobile manipulation is essential for robots to perform useful tasks in complex, unstructured environments. However, existing systems face two challenges. First, navigation remains too coarse for downstream manipulation, which often requires a precise base position and approach orientation rather than merely reaching a meter-scale goal region. Second, navigation and manipulation are commonly trained in isolation, lacking a feedback loop that enables the two capabilities to co-evolve. These limitations prevent current systems from reliably executing long-horizon dexterous mobile-manipulation tasks in real-world environments. To address them, we introduce Nav4Manip, a bidirectionally coupled co-evolution system for long-horizon dexterous mobile manipulation. It comprises two complementary architectures: Nav4Manip-N learns long-horizon navigation and refines its policy through manipulation feedback, while Nav4Manip-M trains a world-action model (WAM) for downstream dexterous manipulation. We train Nav4Manip-N in three stages: multi-task co-tuning learns navigation behavior and manipulation-aware affordance prediction; rejection sampling fine-tuning (RFT) rejects low-quality policy-generated paths and fine-tunes the model on retained trajectories; and reinforcement learning from AI feedback (RLAIF) uses counterfactual preferences to further improve navigation decisions. To support this framework, we establish the Nav-N-Manip benchmark and construct Nav4Manip-Pairs from benchmark rollouts, providing large-scale paired navigation--manipulation trajectories and affordance supervision. Extensive experiments on public vision-language navigation (VLN) benchmarks and Nav-N-Manip demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, while real-world evaluations show that Nav4Manip completes diverse dexterous mobile-manipulation tasks. Project website: https://nav4manip.github.io/.

papers.title: Wrist-Camera Video Diffusion as Generalizable Robot Policies
papers.title_zh: 腕部相机视频扩散作为可泛化的机器人策略
papers.summary_zh: 用腕部相机轨迹表示机器人运动，结合视频预测与几何估计得到闭环操作策略。
papers.abstract_zh: 通用操作策略应当能完成新任务、在陌生场景中运行，并在不同机器人本体之间迁移技能。我们提出 Wrist Video Policy（WVP），一个闭环操作框架，它通过视频预测学习操作如何展开，并通过几何估计恢复可执行的动作。我们的核心想法是用 ==腕部相机轨迹== 表示机器人运动，借助固定的手眼变换即可确定对应的末端执行器位姿。我们把预测未来腕部视角的视频生成器，与一个由预训练 3D 模型改造而来的位姿估计器配对，用来恢复对应的相机轨迹。==模型拼接==（model stitching）把生成器预测的 latent 直接映射到估计器的中间特征空间，绕过 RGB 解码。这种分解使任务知识可以通过大量人类和机器人视频数据扩展，同时让几何运动估计在不同任务和本体之间复用。得到的位姿估计器无需进一步微调，即可迁移到 Franka Panda、PiPER-X 和 Galaxea R1 Pro。在桌面和洗衣房场景中，WVP 可泛化到从精确抓取、插入到处理可变形物体的各类任务，在 zero-shot 分布外评测中**成功率超过 50%**。项目主页：https://wrist-video-policy.github.io。
papers.abstract_en: A generalist manipulation policy should perform new tasks, operate in unfamiliar scenes, and transfer skills across robot embodiments. We present Wrist Video Policy (WVP), a closed-loop manipulation framework that learns how manipulation unfolds through video prediction and recovers executable motion through geometric estimation. Our key idea is to represent robot motion through wrist-camera trajectories, which determine the corresponding end-effector poses through a fixed hand-eye transformation. We pair a video generator that predicts future wrist views with a pose estimator adapted from a pretrained 3D model to recover the corresponding camera trajectories. Model stitching maps the generator's predicted latents directly into the estimator's intermediate feature space, bypassing RGB decoding. This decomposition allows task knowledge to expand through broad human and robot video data while reusing geometric motion estimation across tasks and embodiments. The resulting pose estimator transfers across Franka Panda, PiPER-X, and Galaxea R1 Pro without further fine-tuning. Across tabletop and laundry-room settings, WVP generalizes to tasks ranging from precise grasping and inserting to handling deformable objects, achieving a success rate of over 50% in zero-shot out-of-distribution evaluations. Our project page is at https://wrist-video-policy.github.io.

papers.title: More Than Picturing the Future: Motion-Oriented Latent Reasoning for Generalizable Robot Manipulation
papers.title_zh: 不止描绘未来：面向可泛化机器人操作的运动导向隐式推理
papers.summary_zh: 让VLA的视觉隐变量刻画场景如何朝目标演化，而非未来帧的外观。
papers.abstract_zh: 潜在推理（latent reasoning）让视觉语言动作（VLA）模型能以显式思维链的一小部分成本进行思考，并越来越多地借助视觉预见，我们证明这对预测动作不可或缺。然而这一范式继承自视觉语言模型，在那里它服务于理解而非动作：每个 latent 与一个孤立的未来帧对齐，通常还加入该帧的更多模态。我们发现这会让策略绑定到训练场景的外观上，一旦场景变化，性能就急剧下降。我们认为，用于动作的视觉 latent 应当捕捉的不是未来帧长什么样，而是场景如何朝目标演化。为此我们提出 ==Motion-Oriented Latent Reasoning==，把视觉 latent 从整帧重新引向动作必须带来的交互。语义 latent 遵循具身思维链的各个阶段，先确定要完成什么以及怎么做。在它们的条件下，==面向运动的 latent== 由粗到细地预判每个未来步骤：从全局场景，到由被操作物体及其目的地构成的交互区域，再到机器人状态。相对于最先进的 latent VLA LaST$_0$，我们的方法在 SimplerEnv-WidowX 上把平均成功率在分布内从 37.5% 提高到 55.2%，在分布外偏移下从 22.4% 提高到 30.2%；在 AgileX Piper 双臂平台上，训练场景中从 60.8% 提高到 90.8%，环境变化下**从 6.7% 提高到 37.5%**。
papers.abstract_en: Latent reasoning lets Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models deliberate at a fraction of the cost of explicit chain-of-thought, increasingly through visual foresight, which we show to be indispensable for predicting actions. Yet this paradigm is inherited from Vision-Language Models, where it serves understanding rather than action: each latent is aligned with an isolated future frame, often enriched with further modalities of that frame. We find that this binds the policy to the appearance of its training scenes, so that it degrades sharply once the scene changes. We argue that visual latents for action should capture not what a future frame looks like, but how the scene evolves toward the goal. We therefore propose Motion-Oriented Latent Reasoning, which redirects visual latents from the whole frame to the interaction that the action must bring about. Semantic latents, following the stages of embodied chain-of-thought, first establish what to accomplish and how. Conditioned on them, motion-oriented latents anticipate each future step from coarse to fine: from the global scene, to the interaction region spanned by the manipulated object and its destination, to the robot state. Relative to the state-of-the-art latent VLA LaST$_0$, our method raises the mean success rate on SimplerEnv-WidowX from 37.5% to 55.2% in distribution and from 22.4% to 30.2% under out-of-distribution shifts, and on an AgileX Piper dual-arm platform from 60.8% to 90.8% in training scenes and from 6.7% to 37.5% under environmental changes.

papers.title: SANA-Robot: Efficient World Action Model with Hybrid Memory
papers.title_zh: SANA-Robot：带混合记忆的高效世界动作模型
papers.summary_zh: 4.5B 的世界动作模型，具备分钟级记忆，可在边缘设备实时运行。
papers.abstract_zh: 世界动作模型（WAM）利用视频生成模型的世界知识，通过对齐视觉预测与动作预测来改进动作生成。然而它们的预测开销使其无法在边缘设备上实时部署，而且通常缺乏有效的长期记忆。我们提出 SANA-Robot，一个 4.5B 的 WAM，具有分钟级记忆，可在边缘设备上实时运行，基于以下核心设计：（1）==恒定成本的混合记忆==：我们的 WAM 依靠 linear attention 维护固定大小状态的全局记忆，并依靠 sliding window softmax attention 层传递先前信息，使其在需要整段 episode 记忆的任务上取得高成功率，同时保持高效且恒定的推理速度；（2）统一模型：通过对动作 token 和视频 token 动态施加不同的噪声水平，SANA-Robot 不仅可以作为策略，也可以作为世界模拟器；（3）面向记忆训练和推理的全栈基础设施，包括高效的数据打包与 shuffle，以及基于记忆阶段的异步执行。SANA-Robot 在中等规模（约 5B）模型中取得 RoboDojo 记忆维度上的最佳表现，并在 LIBERO-Plus、LIBERO-Pro 和 LIBERO-Max 上取得最高成功率。在真实部署中，SANA-Robot 在 RTX 5090 上使用 FP8 GEMM 时每个 action chunk 耗时 135 ms，使用 NVFP4 GEMM 时为 115 ms，并在边缘设备上以 **30 Hz 实现闭环、实时的异步机器人控制**，证明了 SANA-Robot 的高效与有效。项目主页：https://nvlabs.github.io/Sana/Robot/
papers.abstract_en: World action models (WAMs) leverage the world knowledge of video generation models to improve action generation by aligning visual prediction with action prediction. However, their prediction overhead prevents real-time deployment on edge devices, and they usually lack an effective long-term memory. We introduce SANA-Robot, a 4.5B WAM with minute-level memory that runs in real time on edge devices, built on the following core designs: (1) hybrid memory at constant cost: our WAM relies on linear attention to maintain a global memory with a fixed-size state, and on sliding window softmax attention layers that propagate previous information, enabling high success rates on tasks requiring whole-episode memory while keeping an efficient and constant inference speed; (2) a unified model: by dynamically applying different noise levels to action and video tokens, SANA-Robot can serve not only as a policy but also as a world simulator; (3) a full-stack infrastructure for both memory training and inference, including efficient data packing and shuffling as well as memory-phase-based asynchronous execution. SANA-Robot achieves the best performance on the memory dimension of RoboDojo among models of medium size (about 5B) and the highest success rates on LIBERO-Plus, LIBERO-Pro and LIBERO-Max. In real-world deployment, SANA-Robot takes 135 ms per action chunk on an RTX 5090 with FP8 GEMMs and 115 ms with NVFP4 GEMMs, and achieves closed-loop, real-time asynchronous robot control at 30 Hz on edge devices, demonstrating both the efficiency and the effectiveness of SANA-Robot. Project page: https://nvlabs.github.io/Sana/Robot/

papers.title: A Glimpse of Training VLMs as Foundation Models for Robotic Manipulation
papers.title_zh: 训练 VLM 成为机器人操作基础模型的一瞥
papers.summary_zh: 提出 nanoAstra，用语义动作建模和保留能力的监督微调训练可泛化操作的 VLM。
papers.abstract_zh: 近期，GPT-6 Astra 在机器人控制上展示出很强的泛化能力，但其训练细节披露有限，如何复现这类能力仍不清楚。我们提出 nanoAstra，一种训练可泛化操作的视觉-语言模型（VLM）的方法，结合了==语义动作建模==与==保持能力的监督微调（CP-SFT）==。nanoAstra 把机器人行为表示为由可复用、带参数的动作基元组成的语义步骤，并以显式的进度描述为引导。CP-SFT 则使用显式的机器人专用系统提示，把操作输出约束在结构化的动作空间内，目的是让适应聚焦于机器人相关的上下文、促进专门化，同时尽量减少对更广泛预训练能力的干扰。基于这一设计，我们在超过 5,000 小时的机器人数据和通用 VQA 数据上训练 nanoAstra。在 RoboTwin 2.0 的随机化基准上，nanoAstra-9B 的零样本成功率为 **17.8%**，大幅超过先进的 VLA 和 WAM 基线以及同等规模的 VLM。在单张 H20 GPU 上，其推理速度快于对应的动作执行，因此模型支持类似动作块的流式执行，使推理与运动重叠，把机器人的空闲时间从 **35.0% 降到 6.9%**。
papers.abstract_en: Recently, GPT-6 Astra demonstrates strong generalization in robot control, yet limited disclosure of its training leaves open how such capabilities can be reproduced. We introduce nanoAstra, an approach to training vision-language models (VLMs) for generalizable manipulation that combines semantic action modeling with capability-preserving supervised fine-tuning (CP-SFT). nanoAstra represents robot behavior as semantic steps composed of reusable, parameterized action primitives, guided by explicit progress descriptions. Meanwhile, CP-SFT uses an explicit robot-specific system prompt to constrain manipulation outputs to a structured action space, aiming to focus adaptation on robot-specific contexts and promote specialization while minimizing interference with broader pretrained capabilities. With this formulation, we train nanoAstra on more than 5,000 hours of robot data together with general VQA data. On RoboTwin 2.0's randomized benchmark, nanoAstra-9B achieves a 17.8% zero-shot success rate, substantially outperforming advanced VLA and WAM baselines as well as similarly sized VLMs. With inference faster than the corresponding motion execution on a single H20 GPU, our model supports action-chunk-like streaming execution that overlaps inference with motion, reducing the robot's idle time from 35.0% to 6.9%.

papers.title: PyRUA-Dex: Learning Programmatic Policies for Dexterous Bimanual Manipulation with Coding Agents
papers.title_zh: PyRUA-Dex：用编码 Agent 学习灵巧双臂操作的程序化策略
papers.summary_zh: 让编码 Agent 无需演示、通过程序化策略开发灵巧双臂操作技能。
papers.abstract_zh: 灵巧操作的学习受限于高质量演示的稀缺：从人类视频重定向不够精确，遥操作无法给操作者提供力反馈，基于外骨骼的采集又难以扩展。我们提出 PyRUA-Dex，一个让编码智能体通过==程序化策略==发展灵巧操作的框架，无需任何演示。程序化策略分两个阶段形成：探索阶段，多个智能体并行探索任务技能及其组合方式，由一个提炼智能体把成功的尝试压缩成任务库和一个程序；精炼阶段，通过随机化布局改进该程序，以提高鲁棒性和执行效率。在仿真环境中，PyRUA-Dex 在 Bench2Dex 上以 72.9 分达到 SOTA，在完全随机化的 DexJoCo 上成功率达 **81.0%**，在两个基准上都领先于所有训练得到的策略。在配有两只 22 自由度灵巧手的双臂平台上进行真实实验，PyRUA-Dex 能高效学会弹钢琴、写书法等任务，根据乐谱学一首新曲子最快只需 30 分钟。这些结果表明，在缺乏高质量灵巧操作演示的情况下，PyRUA-Dex 是用编码智能体开发灵巧操作策略的有效框架。
papers.abstract_en: Learning for dexterous manipulation is limited by the scarcity of high-quality demonstrations: retargeting from human video is imprecise, teleoperation gives no force feedback to the operator, and exoskeleton-based collection is hard to scale up. We present PyRUA-Dex, a framework that enables coding agents to develop dexterous manipulation through programmatic policy, without the need of demonstrations. The programmatic policy is developed in two stages: during exploration, multiple agents explore in parallel for task skills and ways to compose them, and a distilling agent condenses the successful attempts into a task library and one program. During refinement, this program is improved through randomized layouts for enhanced robustness and execution efficiency. In simulated environments, PyRUA-Dex achieves SOTA on Bench2Dex with a score of 72.9 and reaches 81.0% success on DexJoCo under full randomization, ahead of every trained policy on both benchmarks. In real world experiments on a bimanual platform with two 22-DoF hands, PyRUA-Dex learns to play piano, write calligraphy, and other tasks efficiently: learning a new piece from sheet music takes as little as 30 minutes. These results suggest that PyRUA-Dex is an effective framework for developing dexterous manipulation policies with coding agents in the absence of high quality dexterous manipulation demonstrations.

papers.title: World Models as Native Latent Action Models
papers.title_zh: 世界模型即原生隐动作模型
papers.summary_zh: 让世界模型直接充当隐动作模型，从无动作标注的人类与机器人视频中恢复动力学。
papers.abstract_zh: 大规模、多样的视频来源，例如第一人称人类视频和异构机器人录像，蕴含丰富的动态，但要么没有动作，要么没有共享的动作空间。潜在动作模型（LAM）可以恢复这些动态，但它们从零训练逆动力学和前向动力学模型（IDM、FDM），需要在像素重建与潜变量容量和精度之间取舍。预训练视频世界模型原生就能生成高保真的动态，但这些动态以稠密形式表示，并纠缠在所有层中。把世界模型视为 LAM，我们证明只需对模型做极小的改动就能提取这些动态。==Native LAM== 让同一个预训练视频扩散 transformer 同时充当 IDM 和 FDM，以可学习的动态寄存器作为二者之间唯一的因果桥梁，并在仅运动不同的反事实时间对上训练，使寄存器把视频的动态蒸馏为紧凑的原生潜在动作。我们进一步提出视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的预训练范式 ==PAWlicy==（Pretraining Actions from World models），其中 Native LAM 在大规模视频上充当动态教师；与世界动作模型不同，它从不生成视频。原生潜在动作在 LARY 基准的动作分类和控制回归上都优于现有 LAM，并能在新机器人、新场景以及从人手到机器人上重放同样的动作，尽管训练中没有使用任何迁移目标。PAWlicy 使用 3.8B 模型，在用域随机化演示训练的 RoboTwin 2.0 上平均成功率达到 **93.6%，为所有 VLA 中最高**。在 RoboDojo 上，它在我们评测的每个维度上都有竞争力，我们自行评测的 Precision 与榜单领先者相当。在真实机器人上，它在两个任务上都超过 pi_0.5 基线。两个阶段都只使用公开数据和公开发布的世界模型。
papers.abstract_en: Large and diverse video sources, such as egocentric human video and heterogeneous robot recordings, carry rich dynamics but come either without actions or without a shared action space. Latent action models (LAMs) can recover these dynamics, but they train their inverse- and forward-dynamics models (IDM, FDM) from scratch, trading off pixel reconstruction against latent capacity and accuracy. Pretrained video world models natively generate high-fidelity dynamics, yet represent them densely, entangled across all layers. Viewing the world model as a LAM, we show that these dynamics can be extracted with minimal changes to the model. Native LAM operates one pretrained video diffusion transformer as both IDM and FDM, with learnable dynamics registers as the only causal bridge between the two, and trains on counterfactual temporal pairs that differ in motion alone, so that the registers distill a video's dynamics into a compact native latent action. We further propose a pretraining paradigm for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, Pretraining Actions from World models (PAWlicy), in which Native LAM serves as a dynamics teacher on large-scale video; unlike world action models, it never generates video. Native latent actions outperform existing LAMs on the LARY benchmark in both action classification and control regression, and replay the same motion on new robots, in new scenes, and from human hands to robots, although no transfer objective is used in training. With a 3.8B model, PAWlicy reaches a 93.6% average success rate on RoboTwin 2.0 trained with domain-randomized demonstrations, the highest among VLAs. On RoboDojo, it is competitive on every dimension we evaluate, and its Precision, evaluated by us, is on par with the leading leaderboard entries. On real robots, it improves over the pi_0.5 baseline on both tasks. Both stages use only public data and a publicly released world model.

papers.title: DexDuet: Learning Contact-Preserving Bimanual Dexterity from Human Demonstrations
papers.title_zh: DexDuet：从人类演示中学习保持接触的双手灵巧操作
papers.summary_zh: 从人类演示迁移双手灵巧技能时保持手与物体的接触关系，而不只是跟踪物体轨迹。
papers.abstract_zh: 人类演示是双手灵巧技能的丰富来源，但把它们迁移到机器人手上仍然困难。现有方法主要优化物体轨迹跟踪，往往忽视人手与物体的交互方式。即使跟踪准确，机器人也可能接触到物体的错误部位或让手指打滑，导致操作不稳定。我们提出 DexDuet，一个能从单条人类演示中学习 ==保持接触的双手灵巧操作== 的框架。DexDuet 用两个交互奖励来保持人手与物体的配置和接触。为了实现协调操作，我们把双手策略分解为两个权重共享的单手策略，二者以对方的状态为条件。我们还提出 ==辅助参考状态初始化==（A-RSI），这是一种自适应课程，在演示的各个片段上调整物体辅助和训练起点，以克服困难的操作阶段。在横跨三个仿真器、五种机器人本体的四个 benchmark 上，DexDuet 的物体跟踪 ADD-AUC 比对应 baseline **高 11 到 41 个点**，同时始终有更好的接触保持。值得一提的是，在物体跟踪精度相当的 122 组配对运行中，DexDuet 有 117 组更好地保持了人手的接触。代码和视频见 https://rcl-robotics.github.io/Dexduet.io/
papers.abstract_en: Human demonstrations provide a rich source of bimanual dexterous skills, yet transferring them to robot hands remains challenging. Existing methods primarily optimize object trajectory tracking, often overlooking how human hands interact with the object. Even with accurate tracking, robots may contact incorrect object parts or slide their fingers, resulting in unstable manipulation. We present DexDuet, a framework that learns contact-preserving bimanual dexterity from a single human demonstration. DexDuet employs two interaction rewards to preserve human hand-object configurations and contacts. To enable coordinated manipulation, we factorize the bimanual policy into two weight-sharing per-hand policies that condition on each other's states. We further propose assisted reference-state initialization (A-RSI), an adaptive curriculum that adjusts object assistance and training starts across demonstration segments to overcome difficult manipulation phases. Across four benchmarks spanning three simulators and five robot embodiments, DexDuet improves object-tracking ADD-AUC by 11 to 41 points over the corresponding baselines while consistently achieving better contact preservation. Notably, among 122 paired runs with comparable object-tracking accuracy, DexDuet preserves the human's contacts better in 117 cases. Code and videos are available at https://rcl-robotics.github.io/Dexduet.io/

papers.title: ReFocus: Progress-Guided Adaptive Practice for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: ReFocus：面向长程机器人操作强化学习的进度引导自适应练习
papers.summary_zh: 用进度信号定位长程操作的瓶颈阶段并针对性重复练习，改进 VLA 的在线强化学习。
papers.abstract_zh: 在线强化学习（RL）能让视觉语言动作策略通过与环境交互不断改进。然而在长程操作中，稀疏的成功/失败反馈几乎不能说明策略在哪里遇到瓶颈。此外，反复进行完整任务的 rollout 也使这些瓶颈得不到充分分析和练习。为此，我们提出 ==ReFocus==，一个由进度引导的多轮 RL 框架，在 Global RL 和 Local RL 之间交替，以识别任务特有的瓶颈并为其分配额外练习。具体来说，在 Global RL 阶段，我们把每个任务分解为子任务的有向无环图（DAG），再把基于 DAG 的 Progress Reward 同时用于策略训练和瓶颈诊断。根据识别出的瓶颈，ReFocus 选出 ==自适应练习窗口==（Adaptive Practice Windows），即从入口阶段到目标阶段的任务片段，并在 Local RL 中为这些片段分配额外交互，同时更新整个策略。之后，它评估策略完成完整任务的情况，进入下一轮 RL，在 Global 和 Local RL 之间形成迭代。在 LIBERO-Long 和 RoboCasa365 上的实验表明，ReFocus 的成功率分别达到 97.8% 和 51.3%，而 $π_{0.5}$ baseline 为 90.6% 和 39.3%。此外，我们在三个长程任务上评估了真实世界适应。在 BreadBaker 上，**ReFocus 达到 95% 的成功率，$π_{0.5}$ 为 30%**。项目主页：https://refocus-robotics.github.io。
papers.abstract_en: Online reinforcement learning (RL) enables vision-language-action policies to improve through environmental interaction. However, in long-horizon manipulation, sparse success/failure feedback provides little information about where policies encounter bottlenecks. Moreover, repeated full-task rollouts also leave these bottlenecks weakly analyzed and insufficiently practiced. To this end, we introduce ReFocus, a progress-guided multi-round RL framework that alternates between Global and Local RL to identify task-specific bottlenecks and allocate additional practice to them. Specifically, during Global RL, we decompose each task into a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) of subtasks. Then a DAG-based Progress Reward is leveraged for both policy training and bottleneck diagnosis. Based on the identified bottlenecks, ReFocus selects Adaptive Practice Windows, defining task segments from an entry stage to a target stage. It allocates additional interaction to these segments during Local RL while updating the entire policy. After that, it evaluates the policy to perform the full task for the next round of RL, forming an iteration between Global and Local RL. Experiments on LIBERO-Long and RoboCasa365 show that ReFocus achieves success rates of 97.8% and 51.3%, respectively, compared with 90.6% and 39.3% for the $π_{0.5}$ baseline. Furthermore, we evaluate a real-world adaptation on three long-horizon tasks. On BreadBaker, ReFocus achieves 95% success, compared with 30% for the $π_{0.5}$. Project page: https://refocus-robotics.github.io.

papers.title: $ζ_0$: A Framework for World Action Models with Joint Scene and Body Foresight in Humanoid Control
papers.title_zh: ζ0：面向人形控制的联合场景与身体预见的世界动作模型框架
papers.summary_zh: 让VLA策略同时预见未来视觉特征与关节轨迹，转化为世界动作模型。
papers.abstract_zh: 世界动作模型通过预判视觉结果来指导机器人动作，但人形机器人的交互还取决于身体如何响应。仅有视觉预见可能漏掉身体运动，而 latent 距离损失又不能直接监督动作响应。我们提出 $ζ_0$，一个把视觉语言动作策略转化为世界动作模型的框架，它在共享的 latent 表示中同时预见未来的视觉特征和实测的关节轨迹，即 ==场景与身体的联合预见==。训练时，以记录下的未来为条件的 teacher 提供参考动作响应，==双响应迁移==（dual-response transfer）训练因果预测器通过 teacher 和执行中的策略去匹配它。所有组件联合训练，部署时只使用因果预测出的未来。在七个 HumanoidArena 任务上，基于 $Ψ_0$ 和 GR00T N1.7 的 $ζ_0$ 平均成功率分别为 63.6% 和 79.5%，比这两个基础模型高 18.8 和 9.0 个点。在六个真实任务上，分别达到 78.3% 和 85.0%，提升 16.7 和 10.0 个点。在 GR00T 上，其 **79.5% 超过所有对比的七任务联合策略**。项目主页：https://chenyizhi123.github.io/zeta0-project/
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models anticipate visual outcomes to guide robot actions, yet humanoid interaction also depends on how the robot's body responds. Visual foresight alone can miss body motion, while latent-distance losses do not directly supervise action responses. We present $ζ_0$, a framework that turns vision-language-action policies into World Action Models by foreseeing future visual features and measured joint trajectories in a shared latent representation. During training, a teacher conditioned on recorded futures provides a reference action response, and dual-response transfer trains the causal predictor to match it through the teacher and the executing policy. All components are trained jointly, and deployment uses only causally predicted futures. On seven HumanoidArena tasks, $ζ_0$ built on $Ψ_0$ and GR00T N1.7 reaches 63.6% and 79.5% mean success, 18.8 and 9.0 points above these bases. On six real-world tasks, it reaches 78.3% and 85.0%, gains of 16.7 and 10.0 points. On GR00T, its 79.5% tops all compared seven-task joint policies. Project page: https://chenyizhi123.github.io/zeta0-project/

papers.title: Embodied AI Fails the Mirror Test: How a Simple Mirror Breaks Robot Policies
papers.title_zh: 具身 AI 通不过镜子测试：一面镜子如何让机器人策略失效
papers.summary_zh: RoboDojo-Mirror 基准显示，场景里出现镜像倒影就会让机器人操作策略失效。
papers.abstract_zh: 一面简单的镜子能否暴露当今机器人操作策略的局限？受动物认知中的镜子自我识别测试启发，我们研究机器人策略在含有自身倒影的场景中能否可靠地操作物理物体。我们提出 ==RoboDojo-Mirror==，一个基于 RoboDojo 的 benchmark，它保持任务目标、成功标准和策略 checkpoint 不变，把无镜子 baseline 与单镜、双镜和镜面桌面条件进行比较。在涵盖视觉语言动作模型、世界动作模型和 agentic 策略的五个策略上，每种镜子条件都会降低总体成功率：三种条件平均下来，各策略的下降幅度为 10.8 到 56.7 个百分点，在镜面桌面上达到 62.5 个点。由于镜子同时也是物理障碍，我们将其与几何形状匹配的非反光板进行对比：**镜子特有的失败中有 50--88% 没有记录到机器人与板的接触**，因此仅靠直接碰撞无法解释性能下降。轨迹和接触分析则揭示出反复出现的行为，与对倒影物体的 ==幻影目标定位== 以及对真实物体的空间错位一致。针对性的诊断进一步刻画了在倒影附近抓取、随策略而异的推动进展，以及主相机被遮挡时对物理目标的交互。在 $π_{0.5}$ 和 FastWAM 上的真机实验同样显示，直立镜子和镜面桌面条件下总体成功率更低。这些发现表明各类机器人策略对反光环境都存在共同的脆弱性，也说明具身智能的评测需要考虑反射。代码见 https://github.com/iPPLab/robodojo-mirror。
papers.abstract_en: Can a simple mirror expose the limitations of today's robotic manipulation policies? Inspired by the mirror self-recognition test in animal cognition, we investigate whether robot policies can reliably manipulate physical objects in scenes containing their reflections. We introduce RoboDojo-Mirror, a benchmark built on RoboDojo that preserves task objectives, success criteria, and policy checkpoints while comparing a mirror-free baseline with single-mirror, dual-mirror, and mirrored-tabletop conditions. Across five policies spanning Vision-Language-Action models, World Action Models, and agentic policies, every mirror condition reduces aggregate success rates: averaged over the three conditions, the drop ranges from 10.8 to 56.7 percentage points across policies, and it reaches 62.5 points on the mirrored tabletop. Because a mirror is also a physical obstacle, we compare it against geometrically matched non-reflective panels; 50--88\% of mirror-specific failures occur without recorded robot--panel contact, so direct collisions alone do not explain the degradation. Trajectory and contact analyses instead reveal recurring behaviors consistent with phantom targeting of reflected objects and spatial mislocalization of real ones. Targeted diagnostics further characterize grasping near reflections, policy-dependent pushing progress, and physical-target interaction under main-camera occlusion. Real-robot experiments with $π_{0.5}$ and FastWAM also show lower overall success rates under the upright-mirror and mirrored-tabletop conditions. These findings reveal a shared vulnerability to reflective environments across diverse robot policies and motivate reflection-aware evaluation of embodied intelligence. Code is available at https://github.com/iPPLab/robodojo-mirror.

others.title: iMFPO: Improving Mean Flow Policy Optimization with Drift-Aware Velocity Alignment for Embodied Control
